title: Croatian Pilaf with Boudin and Blanc
description: A flavorful pilaf dish from Croatia featuring spicy boudin and savory blanc. Perfect for a hearty lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add boudin and cook until browned, breaking it apart with a spoon.
3. Add pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with boudin.
4. Add blanc to the skillet and stir-fry until vegetables are tender.
5. Add monsoon to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot, garnished with additional monsoon if desired.
8. Prepare any additional sides, such as a green salad or steamed vegetables.
